kolozvari2023.note: Author documentation has response figures, not a complete machine-readable specimen/data package. PEER 2015 material card is NOT these specimens.

lu2015.note: Published OpenSeesPy conversion with boundary reinforcement, N-m units. Not the project core.

regularization.note: Stokley and Lowes: flexure-controlled walls; review mesh and softening regularization before transfer.

formulation_and_native_commands.required_evidence: See per-route native run results. Creation/convergence alone is not physical validation.

material_monotonic_and_cyclic.required_evidence: Concrete tension/compression, steel reversal, FSAM panel response

axial_equilibrium.required_evidence: Per-route gravity relative error is reported for completed diagnostics. Set project acceptance criteria separately.

rigid_body_and_orientation.required_evidence: Rigid translation/rotation, local axes and reversed panel ordering

elastic_bending_and_shear.required_evidence: Independent analytical patch tests and deformation partition

cyclic_experiment.required_evidence: Signed envelope, unloading/reloading, pinching, residual displacement, energy per cycle

mesh_objectivity.required_evidence: Mesh and macro-fiber refinement with fracture-energy regularization

biaxial_and_torsion.required_evidence: Nonplanar shared corners, 0/45/90 degree loading and torsion

openings_and_coupling.required_evidence: Actual openings, coupling members and corner connectivity

out_of_plane_and_instability.required_evidence: Out-of-plane bending/buckling and geometric nonlinearity applicability

dynamic_convergence.required_evidence: Time-step refinement, convergence recovery, mass and damping sensitivity

independent_validation.required_evidence: Different specimen than calibration; applicable axial-load/aspect/detail range

building_transfer.required_evidence: Actual unconfined core reinforcement/materials and gravity/modal checks
